arm_definitions.A: raw sequence position plus original absolute pitch
arm_definitions.C: unary musical time geometry plus original absolute pitch
arm_definitions.D: C plus pairwise relational time geometry
arm_definitions.E: D plus fixed chromatic-circle pitch projection
arm_definitions.F: D with original absolute pitch on the music21 high-confidence subset
arm_definitions.G: D with music21 tonal canonicalization on the exactly matched high-confidence subset
arm_definitions.H: D with learned absolute pitch-class/register bijective re-encoding

data_firewall.A_E_H_I: full lineage-controlled Pop1K7 split; original absolute pitches; no key labels
data_firewall.F_G: music21 consensus high-confidence subset; dataset key labels unused
data_firewall.test: sealed and never loaded during training or selection

training.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation bits per exact musical event
